cases.productGap: Actual Vite 8.2.0 worker-backed product runtime now covers install artifacts, hydrated dependency materialization, actual Vite CLI dev server start, browser preview relay, real Vite import-analysis transform, React bare package import rewrite, TypeScript/TSX transform fallback, real Vite HMR connected/update payloads, actual Vite build dist artifact generation, and worker bridge reload recovery. Secondary Vue/Svelte product candidates remain partial-pass and keep PG11 open.

The browser guest runtime Vite product workflow adapter now covers Vue runtime install artifacts, node_modules/.bin/vite CLI entrypoint materialization/resolution, package.json script-driven dev/build entrypoints, RuntimeChildProcess-backed loopback dev-server lifecycle, Vite-like HTTP module serving, preview relay fetch, source edit/HMR state preservation, Vite wire-compatible HMR connected/update payloads, HMR client update events, and build/dist smoke for npm and pnpm. P11 still needs the actual Vite dev server process and real Vite server HMR source connected to this product runtime path.

The browser guest runtime Vite product workflow adapter now covers Svelte install artifacts, node_modules/.bin/vite CLI entrypoint materialization/resolution, package.json script-driven dev/build entrypoints, RuntimeChildProcess-backed loopback dev-server lifecycle, Vite-like HTTP module serving, preview relay fetch, source edit/HMR state preservation, Vite wire-compatible HMR connected/update payloads, HMR client update events, and build/dist smoke for npm and pnpm. P11 still needs the actual Vite dev server process, Svelte plugin module execution, and real Vite server HMR source connected to this product runtime path.

gate.reason: The Vite React reference workflow and browser guest runtime product workflow now pass through actual Vite worker-backed dev, preview, edit/HMR, build/dist, and reload recovery. PG11 remains not-pass until the selected secondary Vite Vue/Svelte candidate workflows are either product-supported or explicitly moved to public limitations.
requiredToPass: Promote or explicitly defer Vite Vue runtime product workflow after real plugin/module execution review
